title: Symmetric Recompression Reveals Compression Shortcuts in AI-Generated Art Detection: code and result files
description: Google Colab notebooks, the list of sampled images, and the result files for a study of JPEG compression shortcuts in AI-generated art detection on the AI-ArtBench benchmark. A fine-tuned ResNet50 detector and a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 encoder with a linear classifier are trained under three preprocessing conditions that differ only in compression history; the repository contains the compression matrix, cross-generator tests, color ablation, occlusion-map analyses, second-seed replications, and an audit of the JPEG settings of all 185,015 dataset files. No dataset images are included.
